intro X C hC h
apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add
intro η hη _
have hηr : (0 : ℝ) < η := hη

rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hC.le, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hC.ne'] at hb
simpa only [zero_add, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] using hb
